LanguageData.MiliraXian_BackStoryChild_Qinghe_BS1.des:
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up among many kinds of flowers. Among the six branches born from "Ji", her resonance with "life" was deepest. From the first time she heard the flowers' words, they became part of her life. Her strong affinity for Ji energy and talent from an early age made her one of Neiyu's first students, and she achieved excellent results in her cultivation.
"Oh... the time I spent studying with my teacher... I could write a whole book about that."
LanguageData.MiliraXian_BackStoryAdult_Qinghe_BS1.des:
After leaving the garden in the distant immortal realm, [PAWN_nameDef] devoted herself to spreading the blessings of the hundred flowers across this unfamiliar, ravaged land.
"If even one flower in the court is still willing to bloom, I cannot leave yet."
